description: This file defines the ConceptReferenceTermEditor class, which extends PropertyEditorSupport to handle conversion between String representations and ConceptReferenceTerm objects within the OpenMRS API. It includes methods to set the value based on text input and to retrieve the text representation of the ConceptReferenceTerm.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermEditor
classes.description: A property editor for converting between String and ConceptReferenceTerm objects for use in the OpenMRS context.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String input into a ConceptReferenceTerm object, either by integer ID or UUID, and sets it as the current value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the String representation (ID) of the current ConceptReferenceTerm value.
